head: a970592c50f66fc3ea90c8e9d83c6ef7d2665384
summary: Round 1 code is unchanged. Since then, three commits add a risk-service Dockerfile, run risk-service with Redis and its own PostgreSQL in the e2e stack, and build the image in ci.yml and scripts/e2e.sh, as staff decision 0010 prescribes. The Dockerfile follows the existing service pattern, and the stack uses the RISK_* variables from risk-service application.yml. Local run is 498/498 on a clean tree at HEAD, and CI End-to-end tests on HEAD is success. No blocker or major findings. The Autonomy gate check is red on HEAD, which is expected because ci.yml is a protected path and needs staff-approved. It is outside this review.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Unchanged since round 1 and now also proven end to end. The e2e stack runs the real risk-service, and the e2e suite is green on HEAD. PaymentSagaIT covers the ordering: ReserveFunds appears only after RiskApproved, and RiskRejected rejects the payment with no ledger commands.
ADR 0011 and ADR 0012 are updated. Redelivered and stale risk replies change nothing, and the auto-approval in PaymentInitiated is removed.

findings.description: Carried over from round 1. The AssessRisk field mapping is asserted only through PaymentSagaIT.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add a small adapter test if the mapping grows.
